sources.note: Munda languages show competing word-level (weak-strong) vs phrase-level (strong-weak) prosodic domains; the word-level strong syllable is the cognate root. The abstract frames Munda prosody as prominence/stress, makes no lexical-tone claim; likely relevant to Juang only as a member of the comparison (iambic word prosody), tone not expected to be attributed to Juang.
sources.venue: Journal of South Asian Languages and Linguistics
